codeQuality.summary: Critical security vulnerabilities identified. All three new search functions use string concatenation for SQL queries instead of parameterized queries, creating SQL injection vulnerabilities. No input validation despite existing utilities. No error handling. Code violates established project patterns.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Function interpolates user input without parameterization. Needs SQL injection testing.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('should prevent SQL injection', () => { const r = searchTodos("' OR '1'='1"); expect(r).toEqual([]); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: String parameter enables type confusion. No validation tests.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('should handle invalid status', () => { expect(() => searchTodosByStatus('yes')).toThrow(); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Multi-tenant function lacks data isolation verification.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('User A cannot access User B todos', () => { expect(getTodosByUser('B').every(t => t.userId === 'B')).toBe(true); });
it('should throw for null input', () => { expect(() => searchTodos(null)).toThrow(); });
it('should treat % as literal', () => { expect(searchTodos('50%').every(t => t.title.includes('50%'))).toBe(true); });

testCoverage.summary: Zero test coverage. Critical security vulnerabilities remain untested. Minimum 30 tests required for SQL injection, data isolation, and edge cases.

recommendations.description: All three search functions contain SQL injection vulnerabilities through string interpolation. Must use parameterized queries before merge.
searchTodosByStatus() accepts string instead of boolean, enabling type confusion attacks. Change parameter type.
Zero test coverage for new functions. Minimum 30 tests required covering SQL injection, data isolation, and edge cases.
Functions lack input validation despite existing utilities. Add null checks, length limits, and format validation.
No error handling around database queries. Implement try-catch with logging and custom error types.
getTodosByUser() needs verification of multi-tenant data isolation. Add tests preventing cross-user access.
LIKE queries lack indexes. No pagination causes memory exhaustion. Add pagination support.
Remove vulnerability markers from comments. Replace with secure implementation documentation.
Extract common query execution pattern into reusable helper function.
Replace type assertions with Zod schema validation for runtime safety.
